units.source_text: 千重子经苗子一提醒，抬头扫视了一遍四周的山。

en.t: Prompted by Naeko, Chieko lifted her head and swept her eyes over the mountains around them.

units.source_text: 山峦冷冷地蒙上一层蒙蒙的雨雾。

en.t: The mountains were coldly veiled in a faint mist of rain.

units.source_text: 挺立在山脚下的杉树，反而显得更加清新了。

en.t: The cedar trees standing tall at the foot of the mountains looked all the fresher by contrast.
